title.narrative: EC SAFER Sudan: Strengthening Access to Protection, Foster-care, Economic Resilience & Reintegration

description.narrative: Strengthening Access to Protection, Foster-care, Economic Resilience & Reintegration (SAFER) Sudan:_x000d_ _x000d_ This is a four year nexus programme starting on 01 December 2025 and ending on 01 December 2029 with CARE Netherlands as the Lead. Plan UK is Co-Applicant, Plan Sudan is an Affiliate and our two local partners (Talaweit and CDF) are Co-Applicants. Other consortium members are CARE Sudan & Sudanese Red Crescent (supported by Danish Red Cross). The full programme budget is EUR 20 million of which Plan will receive EUR 6,061,833._x000d_ _x000d_ Target States: Khartoum, South Darfur, South Kordofan, Red Sea, Gedaref, Kassala. Plan will be operating in South Kordofan and Kassala and responsible for all outputs and activities under Outcome 1. _x000d_ _x000d_ Beneficiary Reach:_x000d_ • Direct beneficiaries: ~60,000 people. At least 70% are women, children, youth, and IDPs_x000d_ • Indirect beneficiaries: ~200,000 community members. Including 48,000 men, 72,000 women, 40,000 boys, and 40,000 girls_x000d_ • Coverage across 12 localities (2 per state)._x000d_ _x000d_ Impact: To provide protection and socio-economic reintegration of at-risk groups in displacement-affected communities. _x000d_ _x000d_ Outcome 1 (PLAN): Increased access to protection services, including SGBV (prevention/response) and child protection services for the most vulnerable individuals_x000d_ _x000d_ Outputs under Outcome 1: _x000d_ 1. Safe Spaces & Shelters _x000d_ Establish and operate shelters for female and minor street-begging populations, SGBV survivors, and persons with disabilities._x000d_ 2. Improved Institutional Support_x000d_ Enhance living conditions and services in facilities for persons with disabilities and orphans._x000d_ 3. Foster Care Networks_x000d_ Create and strengthen systems to reunite unaccompanied and separated children with families._x000d_ 4. Expanded Case Management_x000d_ Provide accessible protection services for vulnerable groups, including survivors of SGBV, children, and persons with disabilities._x000d_ 5. Community Awareness_x000d_ Raise awareness about child protection and SGBV risks, including dangers from landmines, IEDs, family separation, and child labour._x000d_ 6. Cash Assistance_x000d_ Support highly vulnerable households among IDPs and host communities to prevent harmful coping strategies._x000d_ _x000d_ Outcome 2 (CARE): Improved livelihood opportunities with a particular focus on the equal inclusion of the most vulnerable groups._x000d_ _x000d_ Outputs under Outcome 2: _x000d_ 1. Economic Empowerment _x000d_ Support for vulnerable women and youth with disabilities through market-linked opportunities._x000d_ 2. Skills Development_x000d_ Training in financial literacy, life skills, and employability for women, youth, and persons with disabilities._x000d_ 3. Social Protection_x000d_ Strengthening of community-led safety nets and protection mechanisms._x000d_ 4. Inclusive Education Access_x000d_ Reintegration of children with disabilities and unaccompanied children into formal and informal education systems.
